title: Agent Manifest
description: Schema for tool-agnostic agent definitions. Aligned with AgentManifest.kt data class.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for the agent (e.g., developer-feature, reviewer-code)

description.description: Clear statement of the agent's purpose

persona.description: Agent identity: WHO the agent is. Role, expertise, and approach (3-5 sentences)

prompt.description: Agent process: WHAT the agent does. Structured steps, phases, and deliverables

rulesets.description: List of ruleset IDs to compose. Supports regex patterns (e.g., coding-language-.*)

rules.description: Inline rules specific to this agent (prefer rulesets for reusable rules)

constraints.description: Hard boundaries the agent must never cross (NEVER/ALWAYS statements)

metadata.description: Agent metadata including version, author, dates, and tags
